{
  "found": true,
  "rule": {
    "trigger_kind": "incident",
    "event": "sfp_replaced",
    "symptoms": [
      "link_up",
      "counters_zero"
    ],
    "stated_condition": "older boxes",
    "condition_is_relative": true,
    "action": "interface.bounce",
    "action_text": "bounce the port",
    "avoid": [
      "node.reboot"
    ],
    "excerpt": "Link was up, counters at zero. Erkki told me last time that on these older boxes you just bounce the port instead of rebooting, so I did that and it worked.",
    "said_by": "Veikko Vikkelä",
    "said_by_role": "field_engineer",
    "hedged": false,
    "first_hand": true,
    "outcome": "recovered",
    "outcome_excerpt": "Link was up, counters at zero. Erkki told me last time that on these older boxes you just bounce the port instead of rebooting, so I did that and it worked.",
    "about_entity": "TRN-063",
    "retracts": false
  },
  "reason": "The field engineer states a reusable rule for when a link is up with zero counters after an SFP change on older boxes: bounce the port instead of rebooting, which worked."
}
